about: FR-49/51/52/53 reflex and clock knobs (docs/v2/CONTRACTS.md §9.18). The kernel reads this file at boot (K.cfg.reflex); a missing or invalid file or key means the built-in defaults shown here. Actions: clock (timestream off, FPS cap at clock.siege_cap), gates (every linked drawbridge up), doors (entrance doors forbidden: next to open sky and on seal's entrance routes), alert (civ alert; seal picks the burrow: Kern+, else Innen+, kept for the lockdown).
